claim_limits: Q1 original 51/64 assurance-first and fixed-A control share the same biological mating condition but are separate registered cohorts/visitor histories; this is not within-path proof that first crossing was necessary.

The new 8-founder fixed-A absolute decline and 2-way crossed intervals are SOURCE-VERIFIED RETROSPECTIVE descriptive readouts of the predeclared 1088 case cohort, not a new prespecified four-setting success test.
Ability to evolve A is blocked at A=0.5, NOT autonomous selfing itself.
An allele support set cannot expand ONLY when locus mutation and immigration are both absent; the actual 0.01-mutating A-width cohort does not satisfy the no-mutation premise.
Initial assurance half-width changes standing genetic variance, support and later dynamics together, not segregation variance alone.
315 / 1238 is outcome-conditioned on first-exclusion transitions from same 2304 histories, not a prospective allele-loss probability or percentage of density finite discrepancies.
The 3/32, 2/32 genotype-density comparison is a separate original cohort; density omits individual self-pollen exclusion and is not the finite model's stochastic expectation.
Do not use unsupported rounded component tuple selection=-0.050, parent=+0.022, segregation=+0.008 for the 3/32,2/32 histories without a source-matched component table and identical estimand.

original_same_mating_condition.biological_condition: delayed selfing with direct assurance cost=0.5 and positive A mutation 0.01; separate matched intervention histories, not the same individual trajectories

assurance_first.event_definition: A increase vs I decline each founder-relative 0.05 sustained for 20 censuses, ties within 5 updates

fixed_A_counterexample.source_note: See fixed_assurance record for full precision and interval; source is distinct 64-history confirmation

original_same_mating_condition.mathematical_scope: One valid counterexample to a universal evolutionary-necessity claim; NOT proof selfing is unnecessary.

bootstrap.method: two-way crossed founder and visitor bootstrap of raw 8x8 paired cells; 9999 resamples, seed 5606162026
bootstrap.status: retrospective independent descriptive fixed-A readout, not original primary prespecified D interval

fresh_founder_q1.global_support: A genetic-capacity evolution not necessary for far-side I decline in this Model3 family, all four settings and all 8 fresh-founder means; compression under A evolution positive 3/4, direct cost inconclusive

support_theorem.hypotheses: Per locus no new mutation and no immigration; ordinary Mendelian allele inheritance with bounded allelic values
support_theorem.statement: If S_t is the set of allele values at locus L in extant plants then S_(t+1) subset S_t. Hence possible individual and population means of (allele_m+allele_p)/2 lie in [min S_0,max S_0]. If S_0={m-h,m+h} then maximal rise from initial m is h. Loss is absorbing under the same no-mutation/no-immigration law.
support_theorem.scope_warning: Initial allele-width h is half-width around initial mean m, not the full diameter; when mutation occurs, S_t inclusion and an absorbing loss do not hold.

support_loss.exact_law: No investment-locus mutation or immigration; historical cost/condition does not establish no A mutation.
support_loss.inference_unit: 703 are original histories; 315/1238 are loss-selected transition records within those same original 2304 histories

allele_half_width_order_exploration.scope: For d=0.025 both standing ranges allow the target; order-score sign changes at all six founder×context cells in the finite source grid; mutation A active, so no isolated causal selection-versus-segregation split or continuous visitor threshold.

density_finite_realization.inference_limit: Density non-equivalent to finite ABM; genetic loss in distinct 2304-history cohort not proven to mediate this forecast mismatch.
